en_title: Marvel Announces New Spy TV Series Zodiac, Coming in 2028
subtitle: 神盾局的秘密
opus_summary: 漫威影业公布间谍惊悚剧《Zodiac》，将于2028年登陆Disney+。该剧将在未来几周启动选角，明年开拍，故事似乎围绕神盾局展开，登场英雄尚未公布。

paragraphs.en: Marvel Studios has announced a brand new TV series called Zodiac, which will release in 2028.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威影业公布了全新剧集《Zodiac》，将于2028年播出。

paragraphs.en: The show was officially announced at New York Comic-Con, but was reported on last month. The Hollywood Reporter had mentioned it as a secondary piece of information when reporting on the cancellation of Daredevil: Born Again . Not much is known about the project other than it is a spy story that will seemingly center around Marvel's secretive government organization, SHIELD.
paragraphs.cn: 该剧在纽约漫展上正式公布，不过上个月就已有相关报道。好莱坞报道者在报道《夜魔侠：重生》被取消时，曾顺带提到这部剧。目前关于该项目的信息不多，只知道它讲述的是一个间谍故事，似乎将围绕漫威旗下的秘密政府组织神盾局展开。

paragraphs.en: JUST ANNOUNCED AT NYCC: Marvel Television’s Zodiac is coming to Disney+ in 2028. https://t.co/PZ3RqguZVZ
paragraphs.cn: 纽约漫展刚刚公布：漫威电视的《Zodiac》将于2028年登陆Disney+。https://t.co/PZ3RqguZVZ

paragraphs.en: Marvel has confirmed that it will begin casting the show in the next few weeks and the series will begin filming next year. The series, like other MCU shows, will premiere on Disney+. It's unclear exactly what the show will be about beyond the fact it's a spy-thriller. We also have no idea which Marvel heroes will be in it. It wouldn't be surprising if Samuel L. Jackson's Nick Fury makes an appearance given his role within SHIELD. We can only hope that it's better than Secret Invasion, a series that Jackson led but was deemed to be a failure.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威确认，该剧将在未来几周启动选角，明年开拍。与其他漫威电影宇宙剧集一样，该剧将在Disney+首播。除了确定它是一部间谍惊悚剧之外，具体剧情仍不清楚，我们也不知道哪些漫威英雄会登场。考虑到尼克·弗瑞在神盾局中的身份，如果塞缪尔·杰克逊饰演的这一角色登场，也不会令人意外。我们只能希望它比《秘密入侵》更好，毕竟那部由杰克逊主演的剧集被认为是失败之作。

paragraphs.en: With the show releasing in 2028, it may also be set after Avengers: Secret Wars, which Jackson confirmed he will star in . The next two Avengers movies are expected to lay the ground work for a larger reset of the MCU , though Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige has denied that it will be a total reboot of the franchise.
paragraphs.cn: 由于该剧将于2028年播出，故事也可能设定在《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》之后，杰克逊已确认会出演这部电影。接下来的两部《复仇者联盟》电影预计将为漫威电影宇宙更大规模的重置打下基础，不过漫威影业负责人凯文·费奇否认这会是对整个系列的彻底重启。
